_about: Starting kit and load limits for Lania. Rope and tar come from the ledger (draft: bought in Adrer); the rest is new and draft.

start_inventory.name: coil of rope
start_inventory.description: Thirty paces of tarred hemp rope, bought in Adrer for the fen crossings.

start_inventory.name: pot of tar
start_inventory.description: A stoppered clay pot of pine tar for sealing packs.

start_inventory.name: brass lantern
start_inventory.description: A shuttered brass lantern with oil enough for a long night.

start_inventory.name: tinderbox
start_inventory.description: Flint, steel and dry tinder in a tin box.

start_inventory.name: bundle of smoked rations
start_inventory.description: Three days of hard bread and smoked fish.

start_inventory.name: bedroll
start_inventory.description: A rolled wool blanket and oilcloth.

start_inventory.name: journal
start_inventory.description: A leather journal, mostly blank. WRITE to add to it; JOURNAL to read it.

start_inventory.name: pencil
start_inventory.description: A stub of graphite in a wooden sleeve.
